About

Everything runs in your browser — images are never uploaded to a server.

Pixelator by Cross Canvas Art Studio — pixelate photos and images into retro pixel art mosaics, free and straight in your browser.

GitHub Stitchee — cross-stitch pattern maker

© 2026 Stitchee. Projects are stored in your browser only.

How it works

  1. Upload an image — drag & drop or click to browse.
  2. Pixel size — each block becomes a pixel; bigger blocks make a chunkier mosaic.
  3. Colours — cap the palette for a cleaner retro look, or enable dithering.
  4. Adjust — tune brightness, contrast and saturation before pixelating.
  5. Compare — drag the handle on the canvas to see before and after.
  6. Export — download the pixel art as a PNG at your chosen size.
